principles: Every capability names its canonical entity families and truth authority before implementation.
Published curriculum releases are immutable; learner and user state is versioned separately.
Offline work is explicit, idempotent, observable, resumable, and never silently discarded.
Derived projections never become an untraceable second source of truth.
Privacy, provenance, migration, conflict, audit, recovery, and deletion are product behavior rather than backend footnotes.

concerns.requirement: Version stable IDs, aliases, universal resource references, and legacy mappings independently from labels and paths.
Declare schema versions, forward and backward migration, fixtures, partial-failure behavior, and rollback.
Retain source, author, reviewer, timestamps, hashes, transformation chain, citations, and model or prompt versions where applicable.
Run structural, semantic, referential, locale-pair, safety, range, and integrity validation before authority changes.
Define local and remote repositories, transaction boundaries, atomic writes, corruption detection, and durable receipts.
Define exact, filtered, cross-locale, personal-content, and semantic search behavior with deterministic fallback and reindex policy.
Name cache owner, freshness, invalidation, quota, eviction, prefetch, and stale presentation behavior.
Define queued operations, idempotency, dependency ordering, retry, cancellation, expiry, and user-visible status.
Define change capture, revision protocol, tombstones, batching, partial failure, reconciliation, and lifecycle triggers.
Choose domain-specific automatic or user-assisted merge, preserve audit history, and retain lossless fallback copies.
Classify data, minimize collection, enforce consent and local or remote boundaries, and support export, deletion, and redaction.
Name server, package, local, or derived authority; apply least privilege, secret isolation, access control, encryption posture, and abuse limits.
Record append-only truth events where needed with correlation IDs, actor, reason, timestamp, and replay or administrative evidence.
Define backup, restore, reindex, corrupt-record quarantine, migration rollback, cache rebuild, and disaster runbooks.
Expose privacy-safe metrics, traces, typed errors, sync and package health, SLOs, and actionable diagnostics.

profiles.truthAuthority: Immutable published package for content; authoritative event ledger for attempts and rewards; local-first replay queue for offline attempts.
profiles.offlinePolicy: Published packages and active queues are available offline; attempts use idempotent outbox records.
profiles.conflictPolicy: Content never merges in place; release changes activate atomically. Attempt events deduplicate by stable event ID.
profiles.searchPolicy: Cross-locale curriculum, concepts, objectives, and learner-owned cards with release-aware indexes.
profiles.recoveryPolicy: Rollback package channel, replay attempt ledger, rebuild projections and indexes.

profiles.truthAuthority: Local-first user artifacts with versioned remote sync when enabled; content-addressed immutable source blobs.
profiles.offlinePolicy: Read, annotate, edit, search cached content, and queue mutations offline with visible sync state.
profiles.conflictPolicy: Field or operation-aware merge where safe; preserve both versions and anchors when ambiguity remains.
profiles.searchPolicy: Exact, full-text, tag, anchor, and cross-locale personal search; semantic indexing is consent-gated.
profiles.recoveryPolicy: Blob checksum verification, autosave journal, version history, export, restore, and reindex.

profiles.truthAuthority: User plan and constraints are local-first; server coordination is authoritative only for shared assignments and delivery receipts.
profiles.offlinePolicy: Planning and focus remain functional offline; delivery and shared changes queue with expiration semantics.
profiles.conflictPolicy: Preserve explicit user edits; recompute derived prescriptions from the latest acknowledged constraints.
profiles.searchPolicy: Task, plan, and history filtering; no broad semantic indexing by default.
profiles.recoveryPolicy: Rebuild recommendations from durable constraints and completion events; retain user-edited plan history.

profiles.truthAuthority: Server-authoritative idempotent event ledger; clients render signed or reconciled projections and durable one-time presentation receipts.
profiles.offlinePolicy: Offline learning queues evidence events but does not mint authoritative grants; provisional UI is explicitly labelled.
profiles.conflictPolicy: Replay and deduplicate by event and rule version; never add competing counters.
profiles.searchPolicy: Catalog and history filters only; no sensitive social ranking index by default.
profiles.recoveryPolicy: Rebuild projections from ledger, reconcile presentations, and preserve compassionate continuity corrections.

profiles.truthAuthority: Reviewed versioned evidence and tool definitions; learner responses are event-sourced. No patient-specific authority is implied.
profiles.offlinePolicy: Reviewed cases, evidence snapshots, and tool definitions may be cached with visible freshness and limitation state.
profiles.conflictPolicy: Evidence versions never merge silently; learner drafts preserve both versions when reference context changes.
profiles.searchPolicy: Source, date, concept, claim, case, drug, disease, and tool indexes with freshness metadata.
profiles.recoveryPolicy: Withdraw or roll back evidence/tool versions, invalidate caches, and preserve historical decision context.

profiles.truthAuthority: Server job queue and reviewed artifact registry; model output remains a quarantined draft until explicit review and publication.
profiles.offlinePolicy: Local drafts and job intents may queue; remote execution requires consent, connectivity, rights clearance, and exact source revision.
profiles.conflictPolicy: Jobs are immutable attempts; retries create linked attempts and artifacts never overwrite reviewed output.
profiles.searchPolicy: Private job and draft search with redaction and retention controls; no indexing of raw sensitive payloads.
profiles.recoveryPolicy: Resume by activity cursor, cancel safely, harvest artifacts, quarantine incomplete output, and retain audit receipts.

profiles.truthAuthority: Server-authoritative tenancy, membership, shared content, moderation, and report state.
profiles.offlinePolicy: Read cached allowed content and draft messages offline; send operations queue with membership and retention revalidation.
profiles.conflictPolicy: Server order and moderation state win; drafts remain recoverable and edits retain history.
profiles.searchPolicy: Tenant- and role-scoped search with de-identification, block, report, and retention enforcement.
profiles.recoveryPolicy: Restore drafts, replay permitted history, quarantine unsafe content, and preserve moderation audit.

profiles.truthAuthority: Server authority for account, role, consent receipts, and remote data requests; local authority for device-only preferences and capabilities.
profiles.offlinePolicy: Device settings remain usable offline; security- or account-affecting changes wait for authoritative acknowledgement.
profiles.conflictPolicy: Security and consent use newest acknowledged explicit choice with immutable receipts; device preferences stay device-scoped.
profiles.searchPolicy: No global indexing; settings and role-filtered command discovery only.
profiles.recoveryPolicy: Restore purchases/account state, reset device settings safely, export/delete, and audit every sensitive change.

profiles.truthAuthority: Domain-specific authority with durable transport receipts; connectivity and projections are derived.
profiles.offlinePolicy: All supported mutations declare queue, cancellation, retry, and expiry semantics; unsupported actions fail before mutation.
profiles.conflictPolicy: Idempotent consumers and domain handlers resolve conflicts; transport never invents domain merges.
profiles.searchPolicy: Commands and user-visible job history only; raw transport payloads are not product-searchable.
profiles.recoveryPolicy: Replay outbox/inbox safely, re-establish checkpoints, rebuild projections, and retain typed failure receipts.

profiles.truthAuthority: Verified store or server receipt and signed entitlement projection.
profiles.offlinePolicy: Explicit grace windows and cached signed entitlements; purchases and restores require authoritative verification.
profiles.conflictPolicy: Receipt verification and latest valid entitlement interval win; never trust client flags.
profiles.searchPolicy: Offer discovery only; receipt data is never indexed.
profiles.recoveryPolicy: Restore purchase, reverify receipts, reconcile grace, and preserve transparent history.

profiles.truthAuthority: Immutable source and reviewed content package registries; drafts remain quarantined and provenance-complete.
profiles.offlinePolicy: Local reading/rendering and draft capture may work offline; remote transforms require explicit eligibility and resume receipts.
profiles.conflictPolicy: Create new versions rather than merging published bodies; retain lineage and reviewer decisions.
profiles.searchPolicy: Sanitized source, atom, version, and draft indexes with rights and scope enforcement.
profiles.recoveryPolicy: Rebuild renders and indexes from immutable inputs, quarantine corrupt output, and roll back publication channels.
